title: occurrence
description: One listed occurrence of an event, as emitted by a scraper. Continuous runs (exhibitions) are a single record with a distant end.

source.description: Scraper slug, e.g. wien_gv_at, meinbezirk, porgy, eventbrite

source_id.description: The site's own id for this occurrence; fall back to the detail URL

start.description: Local Europe/Vienna. Date-only means the time is unknown, not all-day

price_min.description: EUR. 0 means free, null means unknown. Never guess

category.description: The source's own label, verbatim. Do not normalise

extra.description: Source-specific fields worth keeping but not worth schematising
